title: Mixed Event — Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles — Episode7 A Present For Everyone

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles
meta.Event Outline: Ichika and Nene aren't sure what to give for Valentine's Day. They ask Honami for some advice and decide to make some scented candles together. Meanwhile, Kanade, who has the same concern, also asks Honami for help...

rows.Line: Valentine's Day
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What's keeping Tsukasa?
I hope he gets here soon.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He has some committee business to deal with... However, it shouldn't take up too much of his time, so he should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu☆
What in that box you got there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm still keeping that a secret☆ I'll open it once everyone's here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That box... It's gotta be her gifts to everyone for Valentine's Day... I wonder what she made...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I also brought my scented candles...
I hope they like what I made...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (N-No, don't worry...! I thought a lot about them as I made these... So, I'm sure they're going to love them.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, your bag seems awfully heavy today...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?! N-No, it isn't... I don't know what you're talking about...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's try to wait patiently in the meantime...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, you've already gathered...
I apologize for making you all wait.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not a problem. School business takes priority after all, but the gang's all here now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah! Alright, Emu!
It's time to show us what's inside your box☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay☆ Happy Valentine's Day, everyone! Tadaa!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! These dolls are so cute!
Wait a second... Are these all made of chocolate...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup, that's right☆ They're chocolate dolls! But that's not all... Take a look at their faces!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
They... They're us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Correctomundo☆ I tried to have them all resemble you guys!
So, how'd I do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You did a wonderful job, Emu.
And this one must be me...
Hehe. It seems like a shame to have to eat it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they're very well made! Thank you, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I hope you're looking forward to receiving something spectacular in return for White Day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! Thanks!
Also, here☆ This is yours, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, this one... It's like her hair's actually tied off on each side.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And its face... It looks just like me.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hehe. She must've worked very hard on these to make sure that we liked them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
In return, Emu...
Well, for everyone really...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? What's happening now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... So...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I made these for all of you.
I hope you like them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Wait, you and Emu both made gifts for us?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You made these yourself, Nene?!
Wow, so many little bags☆ Is this one for me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, yeah... There's one for everybody. Please take the bag that has your name written on it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Let's see... Ah...
You made us scented candles?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Scented candles?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're candles with scented oils mixed into them. They're designed to release a nice, relaxing fragrance when you light them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds lovely.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, Luka, it's perfect for you!
But it's dangerous to leave them lit while you sleep, so please be careful.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, they're all different colors!
That's so cute☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
They seem to suit each of us very well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, hang on... Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I chose colors and fragrances based on the person receiving them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really? Lemme take a sniff...
Oh, mine smells like oranges☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you, Nene.
These are wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome...!
I'm glad to see that you like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't realize that you knew how to make something like this, Nene. Did you research how to do this on your own?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, I had Mochizuki teach me.
I made them with Hoshino... Also, Yoisaki... Remember? She's the one who helped us out during our show the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah...
It sounds like this was a wonderful experience for you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure how my scented candles would turn out at first...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But it gave me a chance to get to know Yoisaki and Mochizuki better... Plus, everyone here seems to really like what I made.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I'm really glad that I did this...)
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... The time has finally come... Happy Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
As promised, we brought gifts!
And everyone seems to be present.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why do I need to be here...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why? Because Mizuki and the others said they'd bring gifts for all of us, so we should all be here to accept them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. Sorry, but we'll need you to bear with us for a bit.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, fine...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing what you all brought for us. So, who's going to start us off?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I wanna see what Mafuyu brought.
If you don't mind, can you show us?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Sure.
Here...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, this box! It's from that shop that sells those really fancy chocolates. I heard that they're always sold out...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I asked some of my classmates about what to get and they suggested these. I had to wait about an hour in line.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that seems pretty normal for this time of year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you really went out of your way to get these!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mafuyu...
We really appreciate what you did.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's move on to our next present-giver...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow... You all brought so much...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mizuki brought cookies that look like different animals, Ena brought chocolates shaped like lollipops...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heehee! Aren't they cute?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, don't forget about mine.
I worked really hard to get them to look cute by using pink chocolate and colored sugar.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... Yeah, they do look cute...
But I feel like you had ulterior motives...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you said yourself that they'd look great in selfies and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! FYI, I'm allowed to use my creations however I like!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So you did take selfies with them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But it definitely looks like you worked really hard on the wrappers. They have their recipients' names written on them and illustrations to match.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I did. I mean, I wanted everyone to like them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, Kanade, I think you gave us the biggest surprise this time around...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? I did...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! I don't think anyone was expecting to receive homemade scented candles from you, Kanade! Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, they really are!
Plus, each one has a different color and scent!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And knowing you made them with us in mind, Kanade... I think it makes us all just that much happier.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That includes you. What do we say when someone does something nice for us...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Kanade...
I'll try using it when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'm just glad that you all like them so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...? Y-Yeah?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You haven't said a word this whole time. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No... Um, so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Len, I believe you have something to tell them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's she talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
U-Umm...
The truth is... I also have something for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For us...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... Kanade taught me how to make scented candles... And we made one together...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And... Here it is... It's only one for all of you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! L-Len, you also made a candle?! And it looks amazing! It even had flowers in it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Kanade, you really taught him how to make this?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also... I'm seeing sweet peas, roses and all sorts of flowers... They're gorgeous...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So... Kanade helped me pick out flowers that suited each of you...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She also helped me choose the color and fragrance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I had no idea... Thank you, Len. You too, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-You're welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, it smells like apples...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, actually... It's chamomile.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Len, which flower did you pick for me...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, yours is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Good for you, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I really appreciate what you did for me, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You helped make this Valentine's Day feel really special...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No... I should be the one thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You made me realize something important.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun making these scented candles with you and the others.
